In hardware news this week, we're talking about the breaking news of the Supreme Court ruling on US President Trump's tariffs implementations. We also talk about the AI demand impacting the future PS6 and current Switch 2 prices, Valve's struggle with OLED Deck availability (due to the DRAM / memory shortage), and upcoming hard drive shortages. We also cover the unban (and re-ban) of YMTC and CXMT.
